Selected work

Proof over promises.

A public project that shows how I think about reliability, security and developer experience — from architecture to tests and documentation.

01 / DEVELOPER TOOL

Prism Review

A deterministic GitHub Action that scans pull requests for risk signals before human review begins. It flags missing tests, large diffs, dependency changes and security-sensitive files — without executing untrusted repository code.
